Thanks for the heads-up — two quick points: 

1) Marketplace + MSA: We can support an AWS Marketplace listing while simultaneously executing an MSA outside the marketplace. Typical flow is: list on marketplace for procurement convenience, sign an MSA that references the marketplace listing or stands alone. We should be explicit in the listing terms about billing/reseller vs direct invoicing.

2) Pricing: For a PO purchase via procurement we typically offer list pricing with standard commercial discounts. Marketplace rates may need to include the marketplace commission (~7–12%) which affects net revenue; for the customer-facing quote I recommend we present: (a) Marketplace list price (with marketplace fees) and (b) Direct PO price (net of marketplace fee). 

I'll draft a short note with two price options and circulate. Dev — if we need SOC2 evidence or KMS handoff info, please flag any missing docs so I can attach them to the questionnaire.
